rationale: P1 removes dead visualizer and waveform exports from the Pulp widgets.hpp and view_all.hpp umbrellas, and names the direct visualizer dependencies in the implementation, settings panel, and visualizer tests. This is a zero-behavior-change include-boundary carve; public include paths and pulp::view, pulp::format, and pulp::render umbrella targets remain available. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or Vellum source authority moves.
